_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Options (joyau SPX/VIX) en tete, NA Equities et Europe ensuite, Futures et Global FX en fin.

kpis.signal: Pilier #1 Cboe, ~63% du CA total, croissance SPX/VIX options portee par hedging et demande institutionnelle
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues segment Options (transaction & clearing fees nets de liquidity payments, market data, access, regulatory). Inclut produits proprietaires SPX et VIX options. Pilier rentable avec marge operationnelle 72.7% FY25.
kpis.description_en: Options segment net revenue (transaction & clearing fees net of liquidity payments, plus market data, access, regulatory). Includes proprietary SPX and VIX options. 72.7% operating margin in FY25.

kpis.name_fr: Revenus segment Equities Amerique du Nord
kpis.signal: Segment stable ~17% du CA, expose au volume des marches actions US et flux tape plan
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues segment North American Equities (Cboe US Equities, BYX, BZX, EDGA, EDGX) + Canada. Inclut transaction fees, market data US tape plans, listings.
kpis.description_en: North American Equities net revenue (Cboe US Equities exchanges BYX/BZX/EDGA/EDGX + Canada). Includes transaction fees, US tape plan market data, listings.

kpis.name_en: Europe and Asia Pacific Net Revenue
kpis.signal: Croissance forte +24%, +31% volumes European equities ADNV, plus +22% Cboe Clear Europe settlements
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues segment Europe et Asie-Pacifique (Cboe Europe MTF/RIE, Cboe NL, Cboe Clear Europe, Cboe Japan, Cboe Australia). Inclut transaction & clearing fees + market data.
kpis.description_en: Europe and Asia Pacific net revenue (Cboe Europe MTF, Cboe NL, Cboe Clear Europe, Cboe Japan, Cboe Australia). Includes transaction/clearing fees + market data.
kpis._specific_to: Cboe European MTF + Asia Pac expansion

kpis.signal: Segment VIX futures, en baisse FY25 par mix produits, intègre Digital depuis Q1 2025
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues segment Futures (CFE - Cboe Futures Exchange). VIX futures principalement. Le segment Digital (DCM, clearinghouse crypto) a ete reclasse dans Futures a partir du Q1 2025.
kpis.description_en: Futures segment net revenue (Cboe Futures Exchange - mainly VIX futures). Digital segment (DCM, crypto clearinghouse) reclassified into Futures starting Q1 2025.

kpis.signal: Plateforme institutionnelle FX (Hotspot), +13% ADNV FY25, segment de niche en croissance solide
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues segment Global FX (Cboe FX, anciennement Hotspot FX). Plateforme institutionnelle FX spot multi-dealer. Croissance soutenue +13% volume ADNV.
kpis.description_en: Global FX net revenue (Cboe FX, formerly Hotspot FX). Institutional spot FX ECN. +13% ADNV growth in FY25.
